name: Elements | Ultra Thin King Size Slim
description: Made of pure rice paper, Elements rolling papers are bringing back fond memories of the past. The pure rice makes the rolling paper burn extra slow and extra clean, with no ash. A thin line of Acacia gum is added to the rolling paper. The only residue from burning is from the Acacia gum caramelizing.
